text: Ganweriwala Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Ganweriwala Type: Archaeological Site - Settlement Province: Punjab District: Bahawalpur Period: Proto Historic Relative Chronology: 3500 BCE - 1800 BCE Description: An archaeological site in ruined condition comprised mounds A and B. Mound A is measuring 503m x533m x 9m, while mound B is measuring 991m x823m x 9m. Both mounds are culturally associated with Mature Harappan phase.
